title: Shortest Subarray with Sum at Least K
description: Find the length of the shortest, non-empty, contiguous subarray of nums with sum at least K.
pseudocode:
1: prefixSums = [0, 2, -1, 2]
2: deque = [0]
3: minLen = Infinity
4: for i from 1 to n:
5:   while deque and prefixSums[i] - prefixSums[deque[0]] >= K:
6:     minLen = min(minLen, i - deque.shift())
7:   while deque and prefixSums[i] <= prefixSums[deque[deque.length-1]]:
8:     deque.pop()
9:   deque.push(i)

steps.note: Initialize prefix sum array: P[i] = sum(nums[0...i-1])
Check monotonic condition: prefixSums[1] (2) <= prefixSums[0] (0). False.
Check condition: prefixSums[2] (1) <= prefixSums[1] (2). True. Pop index 1.
